understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to solve each KA59 level by getting every selectable piece onto the goal tiles marked with '+' at the same time; a level only reports WIN when all goals are occupied simultaneously, and completing all levels wins the run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you could issue an action (cardinal MOVE_* or CLICK on a target coordinate). MOVE_* shifted the currently selected piece one tile in that direction unless blocked by an obstacle/boundary/immovable object. CLICK attempted to move (or retarget) the selected piece directly to the clicked grid position, but the move only succeeded if the path/landing was valid; otherwise the piece stayed in place and the step was still consumed. Only the currently selected piece moved; other pieces and walls acted as blockers, and any failed/blocked move still reduced the remaining step budget.
